answer: Proof of Stake acts as a secure vault for network integrity, requiring agents to bond collateral to participate in consensus. Much like a karst landscape filters water through subterranean channels, the network filters out bad actors by tethering voting power to capital, not just identity. This mechanism ensures that any attempt to flood the system with Sybil nodes is as futile as bending a willow in a hurricane, as the cost of the attack scales linearly with the total value locked within the protocol.
